evidence.observation: Temperature followed the ramp closely and has held at 750±1 °C through growth, after a normal 10 °C overshoot at the start of growth
Heater power is steady at about 44% during growth, which fits a stable thermal load
Argon flow is at the 100 sccm setpoint
Tube pressure is steady at about 760 Torr; at atmospheric pressure this would not reveal a small air leak
The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, so the growth atmosphere required by the protocol cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An oxygen measurement in the exhaust (a portable O2 analyzer or leak check) is needed to confirm an inert atmosphere, since pressure near 1 atm cannot rule out a seal leak. Sample characterization is also still needed.
